owner.instructions: Which team owns the reporter's complaint? Decide by the reporter's main request, not by incidental words.

criteria.billing: their own money: charge, invoice, refund, declined card
criteria.technical: the product itself failing: crashes, stuck saving, empty exports, API errors
criteria.account_access: getting into, keeping or handing over access: lockout, reset link, ownership
criteria.shipping: a physical parcel or its delivery paperwork
criteria.data_privacy: their personal data: deletion requests, who has seen it, unagreed sharing
criteria.abuse_content: another person's conduct: threats, harassment, spam, impersonation, fraud
